description: Repo overrides on the Mend defaults. Goal: keep the supply-chain minimum-release-age delay AND make dependency automerge reliable.

rangeStrategy=pin is the only way Renovate can honor minimumReleaseAge with uv: given floor ranges (>=), uv resolves to the newest in-range release (possibly too fresh) and Renovate cannot pin uv to an exact aged version (renovatebot/renovate#41624), so the artifact update fails instead of waiting. Pinning writes the exact aged version into pyproject.toml so uv cannot overshoot. shapepipe ships as a container and is not on PyPI (an application, not a library), so pinning is the appropriate choice.
internalChecksFilter=strict: only ever act on versions past the age gate.

minimumReleaseAge=3 days: supply-chain delay so a hijacked-but-legitimate release has time to be caught before it auto-merges. Tunable. NOTE: gates direct deps only; transitives in uv.lock still float via lockFileMaintenance.
